2609.18435.title: WetRobo: A Reproducible Robot Kit for Coding Agents in Biological Laboratories
2609.18435.paper_summary: Automating biological research requires general-purpose, reproducible robot systems that allow individual wet-lab researchers to delegate robot tasks without performing teleoperation or neural-network training. Vision-language-action policies have been proposed for general-purpose arms, but can lose performance when their operating environment changes. We therefore built WetRobo, a robot kit that can readily transfer between laboratories. It consists of one robot arm, laboratory equipment (an incubator, a reagent bottle with a cap, and a Petri dish), the existing code that moves the arm, teleoperation demonstrations of each task that we recorded, and a general AGENTS.md skill file. A biological experimentalist provides natural-language tasks without collecting local teleoperation training data or training a neural network. The coding agent observes the local laboratory and writes and executes programs, using external tools as needed for adaptation. We demonstrate use of WetRobo with OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) on three successful tasks: lifting a Petri dish lid, removing a bottle cap, and opening the incubator door, all in real-world laboratories. The coding agent achieved the cap task in both laboratories, Lab X and Lab Y, whereas a VLA fine-tuned on Lab X demonstrations succeeded there but failed to transfer to Lab Y. These results point to a practical route for laboratory robotics: instead of training a policy for each laboratory, distribute a kit and let a coding agent adapt it in each laboratory. Code, demonstrations, and the evolved programs are available at https://github.com/tsudalab/WetRobo.
2609.18435.paper_summary_zh: 自動化生物研究需要通用的、可重複的機器人系統，允許個別濕實驗室研究人員在不進行遠程操作或神經網絡訓練的情況下委派機器人任務。已經提出了視覺-語言-行動策略用於通用機械臂，但當操作環境改變時，性能可能會下降。因此，我們構建了WetRobo，一個可以輕鬆轉移到不同實驗室的機器人套件。它由一個機器臂、實驗室設備（包括一個培養箱、一個帶蓋的試劑瓶和一個培養皿）、移動機器臂的現有代碼、我們錄製的每個任務的遠程操作演示，以及一個通用的AGENTS.md技能文件組成。一位生物實驗專家提供自然語言任務，而無需收集本地遠程操作訓練數據或訓練神經網絡。編碼代理觀察本地實驗室並編寫和執行程序，根據需要使用外部工具進行調整。我們展示了在三個成功任務中使用WetRobo與OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol)：打開培養皿蓋、取下瓶蓋和打開培養箱門，這些都是在現實世界的實驗室中完成的。編碼代理在Lab X和Lab Y兩個實驗室中都成功完成了瓶蓋任務，而在Lab X演示上微調的VLA在那裡成功，但未能轉移到Lab Y。這些結果指向實驗室機器人的一條實用路徑：與其為每個實驗室訓練一個策略，不如分發一個套件，讓編碼代理在每個實驗室中進行調整。代碼、演示和演變的程序可在 https://github.com/tsudalab/WetRobo 獲得。
